label: About
title: About The Crystal Through the Cedar Cut
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from a saved source, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: a visible mark in the scene opens the real source that shaped the day.

This edition began with one saved post, @Oaknarrow: ナチュラリスト (nachurarisuto): someone who lives close to nature, studies wildlife,.... Its image from pbs.twimg.com set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Crystal Through the Cedar Cut: Roofless cedar collage: a wide band of vertical-grain cedar plank slabs, sliced along a clean paper-cut top edge, opens directly into a blazing lemon-to-vermilion leaf mass. Off-center, an oversized amber quartz cluster erupts through the gap between two offset slabs, facets catching ember light. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped the source to Amber crystal cluster breaching the gap in the cedar roofline.
